title: Ghadeer phir ghadeer hai
body:
Hai Boriya nashee'n to kya ameer phir ameer hai
Adu hai hukmaraa'n to kya faqeer phir faqeer hi
bohot se din hai eid ke Ghadeer phir ghadeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Awaam ho ya hukmara'n madad inhi se lete hai
ghulam apne khoon ki sanad inhi se lete hai
ghulam ho ya ho pisar haqeer phir haqeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Khushi ke din hai fitr azha aur mubahila sabhi
jo masiyat se paak ho wo roz bhi hai eid hi
khushi ke din bohot se hai Ghadeer phir Ghadeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ali nabi ka janashee'n hai baab e shehr e ilm bhi
shareek e noor e mustafa hai pesh aur wasi wali
wo sab hai par nabi nahi wazeer phir wazeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Halaak hone se bachaya usne tumko baarha
agar che tumne har qadam pa murtaza ko dukh diya
madad ko phir bhi aayega Ameer phir Ameer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tere mu'aamile mein kar rahe hai jo agar magar
nabi ki shahzadi haq nahi mila to ghum na kar
Khalifa hogaya to kya, Faqeer phir Faqeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Agarche hur ne sheh ki raah rok kar bura kiya
wo saari raat lashkare yazeed mein raha to kya
wo haq pa hoga subho dum Zameer phir Zameer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Wo shaah e inso jaa'n malaeka ka bhi imaam hai
usi ka sibt e jafar e haqeer bhi ghulaam hai
ghulaam sab bade sahi Haqeer phir haqeer hai
